# Project Code Conventions & Engineering Standards — {PROJECT_NAME}

> **Document Location:** `CONVENTIONS.md` (root)  
> **Lifecycle Phase:** Phase 6 (Build Setup)  
> **Applicable Stack:** {TypeScript / Next.js / Python / Go / etc.}  

---

## 1. Core Principles

- **Stdlib first, dependencies second:** Never add a package for formatting or one-off logic when native features cover it.
- **Parse, don't validate:** Use Zod schemas at every external trust boundary (API input, env vars, external service responses).
- **No dead code:** Delete obsolete code and commented-out blocks immediately.
- **No unhandled exceptions:** Explicitly type errors or handle expected failures with domain results.

---

## 2. Code Structure & Naming Conventions

### File & Directory Naming
- Components: `PascalCase.tsx` (e.g. `AppointmentCard.tsx`)
- Utilities & modules: `kebab-case.ts` (e.g. `date-utils.ts`, `auth-middleware.ts`)
- Database migrations: `NNN_verb_noun.sql` (e.g. `001_create_patients.sql`)
- Test files: `*.test.ts` (unit/integration) or `*.spec.ts` (e2e) colocated or under `tests/`

### TypeScript & Type Safety
- **Strict Mode:** `strict: true` in `tsconfig.json` is mandatory.
- **Escape Hatches Forbidden:** `any`, `@ts-ignore`, and `@ts-expect-error` are banned in production code. Use `unknown` with type narrowing.
- **Explicit Return Types:** Required on all public API endpoints and exported service functions.

---

## 3. Architecture & Separation of Concerns

```
src/
├── app/               # HTTP Routing, Server Actions, API route handlers
├── modules/           # Pure domain business logic and service calculators (no raw req/res)
├── components/        # Reusable design system UI components
├── lib/               # Infrastructure adapters (DB client, Redis, S3, logger)
└── contracts/         # Machine-readable schemas (OpenAPI, Zod, SQL schemas)
```

- **Dependency Rule:** Domain modules (`src/modules/`) MUST NOT import from `src/app/`. Infrastructure adapters (`src/lib/`) MUST NOT import from `src/modules/`.
- **Database Access:** Direct SQL / ORM calls live exclusively in service modules or repository abstractions, never inside UI components.

---

## 4. Git & Commit Conventions

Follow **Conventional Commits**:
- `feat: [scope] short description` — new feature
- `fix: [scope] short description` — bug fix
- `refactor: [scope] short description` — code refactoring without behavior change
- `test: [scope] short description` — adding or updating tests
- `chore: [scope] maintenance or config changes`

Commit messages must never contain emojis or placeholder text.
